== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dewback (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 1 slip 80E), showing the '''PC-E1 (ARMOR 4)''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Dewback (V)]] (original, MANEUVER 4).

* '''Text source:''' [[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-6: “This card should have "Armor" and not "Maneuver."” (by 27 August 2012); [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]) prints ARMOR 4. Game text unchanged.
* '''PC-E1 (ARMOR 4) text:''' “Deploys only on Tatooine. Ability = ¼. May add 1 'rider' (passenger). May be targeted by Trample instead of a piloted AT-AT. During battle, may 'roar' to make a character here defense value -1.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L6253</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>7_312</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 (ARMOR 4) game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
